configuration.label: DreamZero custom negative-branch action guidance s2
configuration.noise_seed_semantics: fixed effective model noise; the 27 environment labels are not independent model-noise draws

definitions.exact_arithmetic: Every sum, mean and shift is serialized as an exact rational number plus its decimal rendering; U=450(1-E)+Z closes for every scope and deletion.
definitions.finite_population_deletion: Delete each of the 27 registered environment labels once and recompute the unchanged arithmetic mean over the remaining 26 labels.
definitions.independence: Registered environment labels are matched labels on one scene and its reflection, not independent physical scenes or independent model-noise draws; deletion results do not establish generalization.
definitions.inference: Deterministic post-result sensitivity for this fixed 27-label population only; not jackknife inference, a standard error, confidence interval, p-value, bootstrap, influence function, resampling distribution, equivalence test or registered analysis.
definitions.sign_retention: All 27 deletion means share the full-population arithmetic sign. This says no single registered label changes that sign; it is not a robustness proof for unobserved labels.

identity.contrast_identity: delta U = -C * delta E + delta Z
identity.zero_masked_recorded_index_symbol: Z = T when E=1; Z = 0 when E=0
